title: Why Palantir Investors Aren't Panicking While the Rest of AI Sells Off
excerpt: Palantir stock is down 30% in 2026, but strong free cash flow growth and CEO Alex Karp's bold forecast fuel debate over its valuation ahead of Q2 earnings on...
content_html:
Key Points

  • Interested in Palantir Technologies Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • CEO Alex Karp's forecast of $15 billion to $18 billion in free cash flow within two years is central to the debate over Palantir's valuation.

  • Palantir's Q1 2026 adjusted free cash flow and EPS both grew roughly 150% year over year, far outpacing the 20% to 30% growth bears typically assume.

  • Palantir reports Q2 2026 earnings on Aug. 3, and the stock trades well below its 200-day moving average despite recent stabilization after a sharp 2026 decline.

Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ: PLTR) is down about 30% in 2026. 

But over the last 30 days, PLTR is up about 5%, while other AI stocks have moved much more sharply in either direction.

→ Plugging In: How Kinder Morgan Powers Up Profits

One narrative says that this is just Palantir growing into its valuation. Even with the slide in 2026, PLTR still trades at over 100x forward earnings and has a trailing price-to-sales (P/S) ratio of about 65x.

However, while inflation readings and the conflict in the Middle East are causing volatility across the AI sector, Palantir has been less affected. That could be due to its focus on government agencies. The company's government and critical-infrastructure client base positions it to maintain growth even during economic downturns.

→ Microsoft Earnings Are Coming—But Azure and CapEx Will Decide the Reaction

The question on many investors' minds is what comes next. Palantir reports its Q2 2026 earnings on Aug. 3. If history is any guide, it will be a strong report. But for the last couple of earnings reports, "strong" hasn't been enough to push the stock price higher.

However, Palantir's consistently impressive results are the unstoppable force pushing a stock price that doesn't want to move higher. Another strong report could change that equation.

→ MarketBeat Week in Review – 07/20- 07/24

Why Wall Street Keeps Undervaluing Palantir Stock

Palantir bears often rely on conservative discounted cash flow (DCF) models, which typically assume 20% to 30% annual growth in free cash flow and earnings per share (EPS). That may be standard for a maturing software company, but bulls argue it is far below the growth Palantir just reported.

Q1 2026 adjusted free cash flow hit $925 million, up 150% year over year. Adjusted EPS came in at 33 cents, also up roughly 150%. Those growth rates are five to seven times higher than what conservative models assume.

Now add CEO Alex Karp's own forecast. He told CNBC that Palantir will generate $15 billion to $18 billion in free cash flow within two years. That's not a typo. It's the number driving this entire debate.

content_html_zh:
要点

  • 对 Palantir 技术公司感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • 首席执行官 Alex Karp 预测两年内自由现金流将达到 150 亿至 180 亿美元，这是 Palantir 估值争论的核心。
  • Palantir 的 2026 年第一季度调整后自由现金流和每股收益均同比增长约 150%，远远超过空头通常假设的 20% 至 30% 的增长速度。
  • Palantir 于 8 月 3 日公布了 2026 年第二季度收益，尽管在 2026 年大幅下跌后近期已趋于稳定，但该股的交易价格远低于 200 日移动平均线。

Palantir Technologies（纳斯达克股票代码：PLTR）2026 年股价下跌约 30%。

但在过去 30 天里，PLTR 上涨了约 5%，而其他人工智能股票在两个方向上的走势都更加剧烈。

→ 插入：金德摩根如何提高利润

一种说法称，这只是 Palantir 估值的增长。 即使 2026 年出现下滑，PLTR 的预期市盈率仍超过 100 倍，跟踪市销率 (P/S) 约为 65 倍。

然而，尽管通胀数据和中东冲突导致整个人工智能行业出现波动，但 Palantir 受到的影响较小。 这可能是由于其重点关注政府机构。 该公司的政府和关键基础设施客户群使其即使在经济低迷时期也能保持增长。

→ 微软财报即将公布，但 Azure 和资本支出将决定反应

许多投资者心中的问题是接下来会发生什么。 Palantir 将于 8 月 3 日公布 2026 年第二季度收益。 如果以史为鉴，这将是一份强有力的报告。 但对于最近几份财报来说，“强劲”并不足以推高股价。

然而，Palantir 一贯令人印象深刻的业绩是推动不愿走高的股价的不可阻挡的力量。 另一份强有力的报告可能会改变这一局面。

→ MarketBeat 周回顾 – 07/20- 07/24

为什么华尔街一直低估 Palantir 股票的价值

Palantir 看空者通常依赖保守的现金流贴现 (DCF) 模型，该模型通常假设自由现金流和每股收益 (EPS) 年增长率为 20% 至 30%。 这可能是一家成熟软件公司的标准，但看多者认为这远远低于 Palantir 刚刚报告的增长速度。

2026 年第一季度调整后自由现金流达到 9.25 亿美元，同比增长 150%。 调整后每股收益为 33 美分，也增长了约 150%。 这些增长率比保守模型假设的高出五到七倍。

现在添加首席执行官亚历克斯·卡普自己的预测。 他告诉 CNBC，Palantir 将在两年内产生 150 亿至 180 亿美元的自由现金流。 这不是一个错字。 这是推动整个辩论的数字。
